title: flow_external_worker_job_fail input
description: Input for reporting an acquired external worker job as failed. The ENGINE owns what happens next: it decrements the retries and re-schedules the job, or dead-letters it once they are used up. Use unacquire instead when the worker simply cannot do the work — failing spends a retry.

workerId.title: Worker id
workerId.description: Identity of the worker holding the lock — the engine rejects a report from anyone else.

retries.title: Retries
retries.description: Override the remaining attempts. Omit to let the engine decrement the current value; 0 dead-letters the job immediately.

retryTimeout.title: Retry timeout
retryTimeout.description: How long to wait before the job becomes acquirable again, as an ISO-8601 duration (e.g. PT5M).

errorMessage.title: Error message
errorMessage.description: Short reason, shown as the job's exceptionMessage in the job store.

errorDetails.title: Error details
errorDetails.description: Long-form detail (e.g. a stacktrace), retrievable via GET /jobs/{id}/stacktrace.

apiConfiguration.description: Optional Flowable ApiConfiguration selector (full or partial UUID).
